meta.name: wjs-converting-wp-to-hugo
meta.description: Use when migrating a WordPress site to a Hugo static site on GitHub Pages from a WXR export (.xml) plus the wp-content/uploads folder — preserving /archives/<id>/ URLs, localizing images, and deploying via GitHub Actions. Triggers — "把 WordPress 迁成 Hugo", "wordpress 转静态站", "migrate WordPress to Hugo", "WXR to Hugo", "publish WordPress to GitHub Pages", "/wjs-converting-wp-to-hugo".
